cleared.check: Shapes that no covered block contains, and whether any line of src/ can produce them.
cleared.result: Absent: MOD by zero, SMOD by a negative divisor, SMOD by zero, SDIV of -2^255 by -1, ADDMOD and MULMOD with modulus zero, SIGNEXTEND with index 31 or more, BYTE with index 32 or more, SAR of a non-negative value by 256 or more, EXP with exponent 256 or more, and MCOPY with overlapping ranges. None can come from src/. Every MOD in src/ is UnsafeMath.divRoundingUp (src/libraries/UnsafeMath.sol:13) whose divisors are liquidity, guarded nonzero at src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:134-140 and :163-169, or numerator1/sqrtP + amount with sqrtP nonzero. Every SDIV and SMOD divides by tickSpacing, which is at least 1 (src/PoolManager.sol:120, src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:19-21, src/libraries/Pool.sol:575-577). The MULMOD moduli are not(0), a denominator that src/libraries/FullMath.sol:30 requires to exceed prod1, or Q96 (src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:252). SIGNEXTEND indices are the constants 2 and 15 and SAR shifts the constants 8, 128 and 255 (src/types/BalanceDelta.sol:24-69, src/libraries/TickMath.sol:61-63, src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:38, src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:219). BYTE indices are masked with 0x1f (src/libraries/BitMath.sol:22, :45). src/ has no EXP. The two compiler MCOPY sites of the PoolManager (pc 9186 and 9400) copy an ABI bytes value into a newly allocated buffer above it, and every mined run there had disjoint ranges.

cleared.check: Task 2: whether the counted blocks are the producer blocks.
cleared.result: For 1001 blocks (block 52,363,132 plus 500 of the 2,406 PoolManager blocks and 500 of the newest 50,000, drawn with Python random.seed(37); list in research/network-risk/cycles/037/theme-hyperevm-producer-census.work/data/hdr-list-sample.txt) the replica header fields receiptsRoot, gasUsed and logsBloom were compared with eth_getBlockByNumber on the official endpoint rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm (client "hyperliquid evm Mainnet" before and after each group): 1001 equal, 0 differ, 0 not fetched. The official endpoint allows 100 requests per minute (https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/api/rate-limits-and-user-limits, fetched this cycle), so the other covered blocks were not compared one by one; for them the replica acceptance rule (nanoreth refuses a block whose gas used, receipts root or logs bloom differs from the producer header) is the evidence, and the replica fetches the producer block itself. 0 batch refusals for rate limits were retried. The F-120 limit stands: storage writes are not compared because headers carry a zero state root.

cleared.check: Task 3: PoolManager instructions that no covered block executed with a given shape, by pc and src/ line, and which an account can reach.
cleared.result: The PoolManager has had two transactions since cycle 33 (blocks 52,363,132 and one in the newest 50,000), so the per-site picture is the one cycle 24 and 33 recorded: of 387 conditional jumps, both sides of 123, one side of 182 and neither side of 82 have run (out/census-PM.json). Never run with a product of 2^256 or more: pc 22316/22378 (Position fee copy, src/libraries/Position.sol:94-96), pc 22445/22513 (exact-input fee copy, src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:65), pc 22585/22639/23094 (getAmount1Delta copy, src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:250-252), pc 22721/22763 (amount above uint160 copy, src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:97) and pc 20958 (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:112, unreachable branch). Run wide: pc 22892/22921 and 23678 (getAmount0Delta). Never run at all: donate (pc 10491/10513 at src/libraries/UnsafeMath.sol:25, src/libraries/Pool.sol:466-480), the exact-output side (src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:88-104) and src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:59. Reach: any account reaches pc 22445/22513 in an existing pool with an exact-input amount of -2^236 or below; it reaches the getAmount1Delta and Position copies wide only in a pool it creates (cycle 34: largest product in the 414 existing HyperEVM pools 2^186); exact output, donate and the amount-above-uint160 path in any pool. Each of these shapes has been executed by the producer in other contracts in accepted blocks (Task 1 counts), including a wide MULMOD with a one-limb modulus 46 times. The reaching calls of cycle 34, rerun now by eth_call with the build placed by state override: hl-purroof (reth/v0.1.0-f0cad31/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu before, reth/v0.1.0-f0cad31/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu after, block 52420387): 10 of 11 equal to pyevm, differing ['C0-gasbound-zeroForOne-exactIn-no-liquidity-walk']; hl-hyperlend (reth/v0.1.0-b92ad36/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu before, reth/v0.1.0-b92ad36/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu after, block 52420401): 10 of 11 equal to pyevm, differing ['C0-gasbound-zeroForOne-exactIn-no-liquidity-walk']; hl-official (hyperliquid evm Mainnet before, hyperliquid evm Mainnet after, block 52420411): 10 of 11 equal to pyevm, differing ['C0-gasbound-zeroForOne-exactIn-no-liquidity-walk']. The one differing script is the known gas-capped open-limit swap.

cleared.check: Task 4: what a wrong word at each never-executed site would change, who would lose, and whether a replica would refuse the block.
cleared.result: A wrong getAmount1Delta or fee word changes amountIn or amountOut of a step and the comparison at src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:69, then the Swap amounts (src/PoolManager.sol:241-250) and the token Transfer logs of settlement, so a replica would refuse that block. A wide fee or getAmount1Delta amount that is used reverts at the int128 casts (src/libraries/Pool.sol:452-458), and a discarded one only decides a comparison with a margin of at least 2^33 (cycle 34). Sites whose result reaches storage and no log in the same transaction: fee growth global (src/libraries/Pool.sol:404-405 and :446-448, and donate at :474-477), feeGrowthOutside on a tick cross (src/libraries/Pool.sol:536-537 and crossTick), the tick bitmap word (src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol flipTick), tick liquidityGross and liquidityNet (src/libraries/Pool.sol:543-557), pool liquidity after a liquidity change (src/libraries/Pool.sol:226), position liquidity and feeGrowthInsideLast (src/libraries/Position.sol:88, :100-101) and protocolFeesAccrued (src/ProtocolFees.sol:68, reached only with a protocol fee set by governance). A wrong word there would pass the replicas until a later transaction read it and produced a different log; then the replicas would halt and the producer chain would continue. Losers would be the LPs of the pool (fee growth, liquidity) or later swappers (bitmap, ticks). This needs a fault in the producer, which only its operator controls (F-120).

cleared.check: Whether the HyperEVM producer census applies to the other 20 networks.
cleared.result: It does not. On the other 20 networks the block producer is either the public client that earlier cycles read and ran, or, on MegaETH, a closed producer whose state root the public validator reproduces (cycles 33 and 35). The bounds from src/ used above hold on all 21.

leads.question: Does the closed HyperEVM producer compile or specialise code per contract or per program counter, so that shape coverage in other contracts says nothing about PoolManager pc 22445/22513 (wide fee mulDiv, reachable in existing pools with amountSpecified of -2^236 or below) and the other never-executed sites?
leads.why: The census shows every shape at the opcode level. If the producer runs a per-site compiled path, a wrong word at a never-executed PoolManager site would show only when someone mines that call. The official endpoint answers like revm, which suggests an interpreter, but Hyperliquid has not published the producer.

leadResults.answer: Census of 52406 replica-accepted HyperEVM blocks (the newest 50,000 plus every PoolManager block): every operand shape that src/ can produce occurs in accepted blocks, and the absent shapes cannot arise from src/. Header comparison with the official endpoint on 1001 blocks: 1001 equal, 0 differ. The reaching calls for the never-executed PoolManager sites return the reference words on both replicas and the official endpoint. No result differs; no finding.
